title: Project Engineer
abstract: Due to Company growth, we are seeking a Project Engineer to assist our team on our new project.
screening_questions: How many years' experience do you have as a project engineer?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Do you have mine site experience?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
content_text:
Formstruct is a Western Australian Owned company, we specialize in design, construct building, civil, structural steel, earthmoving, and concrete construction within the Pilbara region. 
We are currently seeking a Project Engineer to join our team. This role will be Perth based, with potential FIFO
About the Role: 
- Developing construction methodology, schedules, and pricing for submission to client. 
- Maintain effective relationships and facilitate regular communication with Formstruct management team and teams onsite. 
- Coordinating procurement of all materials relevant to the project in line with set budgets and requests. 
- Requesting quotes from all managing sub contractors relevant to project
- Liaising with Planning and Mobilisation teams for labour requirements. 
- Managing project costs, budget, scope of works and project execution to ensure project compliance. 
- Ensure adherence to client requirements as well as Company Policies, plans and procedures. 
- Overseeing site project execution, HSE support, Quality and close out. 
- Preparing and maintenance of schedules and work to tight deadlines and budgets.
- Reviewing and advising on commercial, contracts and scope departures. 
- Submitting and Managing technical queries with client onsite. 
- Maintenance, tracking and reporting on project progress and performance. 
- Working closely with clients, Formstruct management and all other project staff. 
Must have: 
- Diploma / Degree in Engineering or equivalent 
- Mine Site Experience
Please apply via Seek, we will be in touch!
